tweets.author: thebitcoinstrategy.bsky.social
tweets.text: Bitcoin has only ever existed during a period of expansion. No dot-com crash. No 2008. No oil crisis. COVID barely counts, it bounced in months. We have zero onchain data for how BTC behaves in a genuine multi-year contraction. Does that change how you're sizing your position rig

tweets.author: thebitcoinstrategy.bsky.social
tweets.text: The average Bitcoin holder's cost basis is $53,000. In every prior bear market, price fell 10-20% BELOW the average cost basis before reversing. That puts a sub-$50k Bitcoin on the table. Not a prediction. A pattern that keeps repeating because enough people watch the same data.

tweets.author: thebitcoinstrategy.bsky.social
tweets.text: The BTC/NASDAQ ratio shows Bitcoin is historically cheap relative to tech stocks. Same picture vs gold. But "cheap relative to X" is not the same as "bottomed." The onchain data tells a more uncomfortable story.

tweets.author: thebitcoinstrategy.bsky.social
tweets.text: Bitcoin just fell 50% while tech stocks hit new all-time highs. That's not a bug. It's actually the most important signal in markets right now.
